cues: When you fast, glucose falls, and alpha cells release glucagon, which breaks glycogen down and puts glucose back.
Glucagon, adrenaline, cortisol and growth hormone can all raise blood sugar.
text: When you fast, glucose falls, and alpha cells release glucagon, which breaks glycogen down and puts glucose back. Glucagon, adrenaline, cortisol and growth hormone can all raise blood sugar. Only insulin lowers it.
